items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I got a call to go back with the Four Brothers Band for Woody... Herb Steward couldn't stand it, and he quit.

ctx.x: In the meantime, I worked with Tommy Dorsey down at the Beach. I worked with Les Brown at the Palladium. Benny Goodman came out to do a radio show with Victor Borge, and he hired me. Heh, I couldn't believe it, but he did. And he didn't even remember...you know, he's a little bit foggy at times. But I didn't ...(?). . .(?). . .

Let's see, then what happened... Oh yeah, then we were doing this... Oh yeah, I got a call to go back with the Four Brothers Band for Woody, and I turned it down -- I didn't want any more of that road. No, no. And I'm glad I didn't go, because there were too many junkies there, and it might have turned me into a junkie. And I'm glad I didn't go. Herb Steward couldn't stand it, and he quit.
Yeah, that was a wild crew in that band.
